reviewers.summary: viz-3d-grid lattice + signed remainder slabs are correct, bundle/perf/read-only constraints preserved, engine parity with Viz2D verified; no blocking defects.

findings.summary: The riskiest new logic — the interior-offset edge filter (exact-fit vs off-grid) — lived in untested module-private helpers; only the engine remainders were covered. Correctness verified by hand, but an off-by-one would silently ship.
findings.recommendation: Extract the per-axis interior-line rule into a pure, unit-tested engine helper shared by the 2D grid and 3D lattice.

reviewers.summary: FR-VIZ3D-07 genuinely implemented (all six spec scenarios map to code); added to PDR 3D table (proposed); openspec validate --strict PASSED (1/1, 0 issues). Re-verified NFR-BUNDLE-01/TC-STACK-04 (@react-three/three imported only in Viz3DScene.tsx), NFR-PERF-03 (MAX_LATTICE_DIVISIONS cap), BC-VALUE-01/NFR-A11Y-03 (no edit/export handlers). 64/64 engine tests at review time incl. 3 new remainder tests; all tasks checked and code-backed; no scope drift.

Pure client-side three.js geometry (lattice + slabs) + framework-free math. No network/telemetry/persistence, no injection sink (colors are literals; user numbers reach only typed geometry buffers), no new deps/lockfile changes; three.js stays confined to the lazy Viz3DScene chunk. Lattice bounded by MAX_LATTICE_DIVISIONS and validated integer input bounds (dimension <= 15000, module >= 100) — no DoS-y unbounded allocation. BC-PRIVACY-01, TC-DATA-01, BC-SCOPE-01, BC-VALUE-01 hold.

notes: All three fresh Checkers returned clean against reviewed_sha 43e5eb6.
